name: spindle-production-waf-ratelimit
description: Rate-limiting rules for the spindle.app zone. Application-level rate limits still apply in Next.js; these edge rules absorb volumetric abuse before it reaches the origin. See docs/security/waf-rules.md and docs/security/edge-rate-limiting.md for thresholds and rollout.

rules.description: Auth endpoints (signin, signup, passwordless, password reset, 2FA). Tight per-IP budget; real users retrying a few times stay well under it.

rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "/api/contact") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/api/newsletter") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/api/feedback") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/api/nps")
rules.description: Public form endpoints are spam magnets. A managed challenge on repeat offenders keeps real submitters unblocked (challenge only fires once the counter trips).
Catch-all volumetric ceiling on the landing page. Generous on purpose; it exists to stop scraping floods, not to shape normal traffic. Tune against analytics.
